objective: Synthesize a path-sensitive double_free detector that encodes the same local state, guards, and lifecycle mechanism evidenced by the patch, while still generalizing to semantically equivalent sites.

trigger_invariants: the same symbolic resource is released more than once on a feasible path
no reallocation, rebinding, or nulling separates the release events
silence_invariants: the resource is nulled, transferred, or rebound after the first release
a guard prevents the second release on the active path
transfer_axes: equivalent repeated-release sequences for the same resource role
equivalent ownership handoff patterns across sibling helpers
equivalent guard or barrier predicates on sibling paths
equivalent local state transitions around the same sink or dereference
equivalent ownership or release/reinit lifecycle on the same symbolic resource
forbidden_shortcuts: bind the detector to fixed file paths, line numbers, or exact patch strings
broaden into unrelated bug families just to improve hit count
count free/delete calls without tracking resource identity
treat unrelated release sites as the same resource lifecycle
placeholder helper logic or empty ProgramState modeling

constraints.title: Honor mechanism contract

constraints.title: Generalize only on contract axes
constraints.description: Reuse semantics only along these transfer axes: equivalent repeated-release sequences for the same resource role; equivalent ownership handoff patterns across sibling helpers; equivalent guard or barrier predicates on sibling paths.

constraints.title: Track resource identity across lifetime edges

constraints.title: Do not key on local identifier names

constraints.title: Use path-sensitive evidence

constraints.title: No placeholder helper logic
